name: actors
description: Design, build, test, inspect, and safely evolve small systems of communicating Durable Object actors on Cloudflare.

check_on_edit.title: Check actor files on edit
check_on_edit.description: After Claude edits system.ts, an actor, or a message contract, run actors check and report hard errors to Claude. Silent when clean.

strict_evidence.title: Require evidence before stopping
strict_evidence.description: If actor files changed since the last passing actors check, ask Claude once to run the check and affected tests before it reports.

fault_profile.title: Fault test profile
fault_profile.description: Which fault tests the reliability workflow runs: standard (fast) or extended (adds [extended] stress tests).
